name: javascript
description: Implement focused JavaScript changes that follow project conventions and preserve existing plugin integrations.

# JavaScript skill

1. Inspect the relevant code, package manifests, and plugin integrations before editing.
2. Follow the existing runtime, module system, naming, and formatting.
3. Keep changes focused and avoid modifying bundled or vendor plugin code.
4. Reuse existing APIs and dependencies; do not add a plugin or package without a clear need and user approval.
5. Handle input and asynchronous failures using existing project patterns.
6. Run the smallest relevant test, lint, or build check available.
